headline: Nvidia's $105B OpenAI backstop lifts Enslaved God and Zookeeper
body: Money and compute dominated. Nvidia is reportedly guaranteeing up to $105 billion of financing for OpenAI's Ohio data-centre lease, and Anthropic told investors its run-rate hit $65 billion, with Q2 revenue overtaking OpenAI's. Both deepen Power Concentration: a few firms holding enormous resources. That favours Enslaved God (a boxed superintelligence owned by one player), Zookeeper and Benevolent Dictator, and hurts Libertarian and Egalitarian Utopia. The Nvidia deal and an AI-assisted improvement to the matrix-multiplication exponent also pushed Capability Velocity. Smaller notes: a Trump-linked venture selling AI to US-restricted Chinese firms weakened Global Coordination, and Sainsbury's paused a facial-recognition camera after a false flag. Horizon Balance fell to -3.70; Benevolent Dictator overtook Libertarian Utopia.
movers_note: Enslaved God +0.9, Zookeeper +0.6 and Libertarian Utopia -0.6, driven mainly by the Nvidia-OpenAI financing backstop (+0.64, +0.45, -0.48) with Anthropic's revenue news adding to the first and last.
